items.title: Real-life moves, every exercise
items.body: All 422 animations were checked again for realism. You sit on the pec deck seat, arms sweep round instead of crossing, knees and elbows always bend the natural way, and hands and feet stay on the handles, bench and floor.

items.title: Your data, safer
items.body: Workouts and climbs are backed up every day and saved automatically when you're back online, so nothing you log offline gets lost.

items.title: Account is now Settings
items.body: The last tab is now called Settings, with a gear icon. What Monkey learned moved from Training profile into your profile card at the top of Settings, with your top liked and avoided moves.

items.title: Log a climb on any rest day
items.body: Climbing on? Tap a rest day in Next up and log a climb right there, next to Add workout. A climb logged for an earlier day is dated that day.

items.title: Coach Monkey card tidied
items.body: Next tip is now a round ↻ button in the corner, and the chips always fit inside the card.
